text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I decide to let an exhausted Super<n>Creek rest in the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm so terribly sorry for making you<n>worry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I should be the one takingcare of you...
choice_data_list: All I want you to do now is rest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do just that. Good night,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is this... a dream? I mean, it has to be,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aaawww! How adorable! Come here,<n>you little
cutie-pies!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you're so good at crawling!<n>All that hard
work deserves a<n>rock-a-bye reward! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh... I guess it really was a dream.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but I'm glad I could hold such<n>adorable
versions of the three of<n>them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel all energized now. I have to let<n>Trainer know!
♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek apparently got to hold<n>the baby
versions of Inari One,<n>Tamamo Cross, and Oguri
Cap. I<n>don't quite get it, but I'm glad she's<n>feeling
better.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come on, just a little more...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So it was a dream... What a shame. I<n>could watch
them forever.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Aww, I wish I got to hold them beforewaking up. Sigh...
